signal: Fiery launched its FS700 Pro system software platform in May 2026, shipping with next-generation presses from multiple manufacturers.

email.body1:
Matthew, saw Fiery launched FS700 Pro, shipping with next-gen presses across multiple manufacturers this year.

A launch like that floods the pipeline with new accounts, and SDR follow-up volume becomes the bottleneck long before headcount can catch up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps stop drowning in lists: 3-5x more meetings per rep, same team.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to top accounts off your launch signals. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through them?
email.body2:
Matthew, quick follow-up for Fiery.

With a launch in flight, response speed makes or breaks the quarter, and SDR ramp time rarely keeps pace with the volume. The fix is usually less about more people and more about faster, tighter touches across email and LinkedIn.

Want 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70 percent, and I'll show where Fiery's gaps likely sit.
email.body3:
Matthew, last bit of proof for Fiery.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fiery's reply rate likely compares to similar teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Matthew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If easing your SDR team's follow-up load isn't a priority during the FS700 Pro push, no problem at all. A launch quarter is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I'll tailor it to Fiery either way.
